$schema-note: hyg-04. A KEEP-LIST, not a to-delete list. One row per finding the repository has decided to live with: an unreferenced-but-kept file, or a dependency finding (declared-and-unimported, imported-and-undeclared, or claimed-but-absent). Findings the scanner already reports as `keep` (the never-delete list) and dependencies it already reports as `referenced` or `tooling` are not findings and get no row. Every row carries a one-line `reason` and an `owner`. The owner convention is: the backlog item id that will END the row, and a `question-<n>` under spec.md section 14 ONLY where no item ends it. That is why run-relay.ts is owned by hyg-09 even though question 31 names it — hyg-09 is what resolves it — while the shadcn primitives and react-is are owned by question 31, which decided to keep them indefinitely. `node scripts/repo-refs.mjs --check` (npm run hygiene:check) fails on any finding with no row here. A row may only be REMOVED in the same commit that removes the thing it describes or adds a reference to it; tests/repo-refs-baseline.test.ts asserts every row still describes something real.
